title: Brazilian Chicken Skewers with Italian Twist
description: A fusion of Italian flavors with the bold taste of Brazil, these skewers are perfect for a summer evening. Marinate chicken in a mix of herbs and spices and grill to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Brazilian seasoning, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until chicken is cooked through.
Transfer skewers to a plate and sprinkle with parsley.
